europe_now.title: Ukraine Conflict Intensifies with Cross-Border Strikes
europe_now.summary: Recent cross-border strikes have escalated the Ukraine conflict, causing significant civilian casualties and regional instability. The attacks highlight ongoing security threats and humanitarian concerns.

europe_now.summary: EU gas inventories are currently low, raising concerns about winter supply stability. Analysts warn that reduced inventories could trigger a price spiral as demand peaks during colder months.
